title: Maximizing Space: Fit Small Rectangles Inside a Larger Rectangle
description: Calculate the maximum number of smaller rectangles or squares that can fit into a larger rectangle or square. Useful for estimating bricks in a wall or rectangular cuts from plates.

outputs.label: Maximum number of smaller rectangles
outputs.formula: Math.floor((inputs.large_width + inputs.spacing) / (inputs.small_width + inputs.spacing)) * Math.floor((inputs.large_height + inputs.spacing) / (inputs.small_height + inputs.spacing))

outputs.label: Total area of all small rectangles
outputs.formula: Math.floor((inputs.large_width + inputs.spacing) / (inputs.small_width + inputs.spacing)) * Math.floor((inputs.large_height + inputs.spacing) / (inputs.small_height + inputs.spacing)) * inputs.small_width * inputs.small_height

outputs.label: Small rectangles to large rectangle area ratio
outputs.formula: (Math.floor((inputs.large_width + inputs.spacing) / (inputs.small_width + inputs.spacing)) * Math.floor((inputs.large_height + inputs.spacing) / (inputs.small_height + inputs.spacing)) * inputs.small_width * inputs.small_height) / (inputs.large_width * inputs.large_height) * 100
